package.description: Bob the Hamster is a spiffy game, inspired by old arcade classics like `Dig Dug' and `Mr. Do'. Choose to play as Bob the Hamster and gather carrots, or as Vlad the Hamster and smite foes. Playable in both English and Japanese text modes.
